ai.name: AI
ai.description: Cards from text, explanations, hints, answer checks and rewrites with Claude, OpenAI or a local model. Every request is shown before it is sent.

preview.heading: Before sending
preview.summary: {provider} · {model} · {items, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} will be sent.
preview.estimate: About {tokens} input tokens, at most {max} output tokens.
preview.local: This model runs on your computer.
preview.missing_key: This provider needs an API key. Add it under Providers.
preview.show: Show exactly what will be sent

budget.exceeded: This goes over your monthly budget of {limit}.
budget.warning: You are close to your monthly budget of {limit}.

generate.source_hint: Paste a text to make cards from
generate.truncated: The answer was cut off; there may be fewer notes than asked.
generate.added: Added {count, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}}, skipped {skipped}.
generate.add: Add {count, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}}

providers.heading: Providers
providers.none: No provider yet. Add Claude, OpenAI or a local model.
providers.no_keychain: No system keychain: API keys cannot be stored here.
providers.key_set: An API key is stored in the system keychain.
providers.key_saved: Key saved to the system keychain.
providers.session_keychain: Keys are kept only for this session on this system (they may disappear after you log out). You may need to enter them again.
providers.move_key: New address: {url}. An API key is stored for the old one. Send it to the new address too?
providers.intro: Every request is shown to you before it is sent. Keys stay in the system keychain.

routes.heading: Model per feature
routes.intro: Use a strong model for making cards and a fast one for checks, for example.

prices.heading: Prices
prices.intro: USD per million tokens, used for estimates. Providers change prices: keep them current.

usage.line: {requests, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}} · {input} in / {output} out tokens · {cost}
usage.estimate_note: Costs are estimates from the price table.

source.url_note: Only the page's text is read; no scripts run. Nothing goes to the AI until you preview and send.
source.pages_read: Pages {from}–{to} of {count}. Edit the text below as you like.
source.page_read: Text of “{title}”. Edit it below as you like.
source.truncated: The text was long and has been cut. Pick fewer pages or a shorter part.

ai.subtitle: Make cards from text, and choose the providers and models the app may use.

validation.ai_provider: Check the provider's name, address or model.
validation.ai_key: The API key looks wrong (empty, too long or with spaces).
validation.ai_task: This request cannot be sent as it is.
validation.ai_price: Prices must be numbers from 0, with a model name.
validation.ai_source: This source cannot be used (check the address, file or pages).

conflict.ai_no_provider: No AI provider yet. Add one under AI → Providers.
conflict.ai_no_model: Choose a model for this provider.
conflict.ai_preview_stale: Something changed since the preview. Preview again.

provider.ai_unauthorized: The provider rejected the API key (or none is set).
provider.ai_rate_limited: Rate limit reached. Try again later.
provider.ai_invalid_output: The answer was not in the expected format.
provider.ai_keychain: The system keychain is not available.
provider.ai_source: The web page could not be fetched. Try again later.

monthly_budget_usd.label: Monthly AI budget (USD)
monthly_budget_usd.description: Warns when this month's estimated cost nears it. 0 = no budget.

request_timeout_secs.label: AI request timeout (seconds)
request_timeout_secs.description: How long to wait for an answer.

allow_private_hosts.label: Allow fetching local-network pages
allow_private_hosts.description: Off by default: pages on this computer or your local network (localhost, 192.168.x.x, …) are blocked when making cards from a web address.

max_retries.label: AI retries
max_retries.description: How often a rate-limited or unavailable request is retried.

prompt.description: The instructions sent for this feature; parts in double braces are filled in. The request is always shown before sending.

routes.set: Set AI model for a feature
